sql: SELECT year(published_at) AS publication_year, count(*) AS listings_count FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing AND year(published_at) < 2026 GROUP BY publication_year
reason: The request can be answered using the fct_posting table by filtering for open, remote-US, canonical listings published before 2026 and grouping by the year of publication.
